_comment: The MCP client definition for the Unreal editor.
This is exactly what the editor's own console command writes:
Register it at USER scope so it is visible from every directory and needs no
claude mcp add --scope user --transport http unreal-mcp http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp
Do NOT register it at project scope in a project that already has the user-scope
entry - a duplicate shows as 'Pending approval' and shadows the working one.
The port is 8000 unless the editor was started with -ModelContextProtocolPort=N.
Every editor defaults to 8000, so a second editor needs its own port or it binds
nothing and the client silently stays on the first one.
The MCP plugin ships with UE 5.8 and newer only. It does NOT exist in UE 5.5.
